author: Douglas Haber
text: I had M&B come out and do several different services for me. Leo and Jerry came out to pump my tanks and install risers onto them for me. They explained everything thoroughly and educated me along the way about septics. I needed that because I am brand new to Sussex County and learning about them. The next day, Sean and Jerry came back to replace portions of pipe that needed attention in my system. They too were professional, courteous, attentive, and explained everything as they went along. I felt the fees were reasonable and the service was excellent. I will be calling them back and recommending them to others.

author: Adam Salazar
text: Been using M&B since my parents generation. They are a pleasure to work with and have bailed us out with emergency pumps ASAP more than once! Thanks M&B you guys RULE!

author: Haley Carlsen
text: Really grateful for M&B septic! They were able to take my septic inspection report and do all the necessary repairs very quickly. Best price around. They were easy to get in touch with via phone and email. Highly recommend M&B for septic repairs.

author: Todd Crane
text: Used these folks to pump out the septic and pump tanks. Showed up on time and did the work efficiently for a fair price. Would certainly recommend.

author: Paul Ziliotto
text: We've been using m&b for the last few years and their services and their people are fantastic. They do what they say. They show up on time. Highly recommend them
